productDetail.brewingGuide: To brew the perfect cup of Tongcheng Xiaohua tea, use 2-3 grams of tea leaves per 200ml of water at 80-85°C (176-185°F). Steep for 2-3 minutes for the first infusion. This tea can be steeped multiple times, with each infusion revealing different layers of flavor.
productDetail.originStory: Tongcheng Xiaohua tea originates from Tongcheng County in Anhui Province, China. This tea has a history of over 1,000 years and is known for its delicate floral aroma and refreshing taste. The tea is grown in the mountainous regions at high altitude, where the climate and soil conditions create the perfect environment for producing this exceptional tea.
